build-settings.description: Writes Xcode.xcconfig, .swiftlint.yml, Directory.Build.props, .config/mise.toml and Pixi platform rows from package.json and Package.swift

barrels.description: Writes each library's index.ts barrels from its package.json exports and modules

injection-utils.description: Writes each ast-grep rule's injection-utils metadata entry rule and utils it calls from sgconfig.yml languageInjections

outline-catalogs.description: Writes each sgconfig.yml outlineRules catalog from its sources document, its language, and the shared utils, rewriters, and transforms each document calls

rust-analyzer.description: Writes shared rust-analyzer check options and compiler source settings for VS Code

hosting-bindings.description: Writes each .openai/hosting.json d1 and r2 members from its cloudflare.config.ts bindings
